generation.scope: The generic center map is generically finite, dominant and generically etale onto a component of thirty-nodal quartic threefolds. The unordered nodes recover the equation. Fixed-center deformations of the ordered window are trivial.

open_mathematics: Determine marked normal forms for the finite windows with a two-dimensional simple, and recover the discrete fiber of the center map.
